Power, Sex, Suicide: Mitochondria and the meaning of life ...
Power, Sex, Suicide: Mitochondria and the meaning of life (Oxford Landmark Science) 2nd Edition ISBN-13: 978-0198831907, ISBN-10: 0198831900

## 

Power, Sex, Suicide: Mitochondria and the meaning of life ...
Mitochondria, then, are pivotal in power, sex, and suicide. In this fascinating and thought provoking book, Nick Lane brings together the latest research findings in this exciting field to show how our growing understanding of mitochondria is shedding light on how complex life evolved, why sex arose (why don't we just bud?), and why we age and die.
